name: Genya Shinazugawa
variant: After Consuming Kokushibo + Demon Slayer Mark
classification: Human; Demon Slayer; Partial Demon; Demon Slayer Mark
summary: After consuming Kokushibo's flesh and awakening the Demon Slayer Mark, Genya underwent an enormous increase in power. He developed a Blood Demon Art that allowed him to create wooden structures from his flesh bullets and manipulate their trajectory. His Blood Demon Art was powerful enough to restrain Kokushibo, giving the other Demon Slayers an opportunity to attack the Upper Rank One.

stats.range: Standard Melee Range, Hundreds of Meters with his gun; Extended Range with Blood Demon Art

weaknesses: Standard weaknesses of demons: Sunlight and wisteria flowers
notes: After consuming Kokushibo's cells and awakening the Demon Slayer Mark, Genya's power increased exponentially. His Blood Demon Art creates wooden roots and structures from embedded flesh bullets, allowing him to manipulate their trajectory and restrain opponents. His Blood Roots technique can absorb a demon's blood and interfere with its ability to activate its Blood Demon Art.
